releases.notes:
## MI Multiblock Editor 0.1.0

Initial release of MI Multiblock Editor.

MI Multiblock Editor allows modpack developers to replace and customize
Modern Industrialization multiblock structures using KubeJS startup scripts.

### Features

- Define custom multiblock structures layer by layer.
- Map structure positions to blocks, tags and exact block states.
- Configure MI hatch-compatible positions.
- Support multiple structure variants and tiers.
- Optional addon definitions with `.requiresMod(...)`.
- Runtime and recipe-viewer structure replacement.
- Dedicated compatibility for special Modern Industrialization multiblocks.

### Supported addons

- Extended Industrialization
- Industrialization Overdrive
- Yet Another Industrialization

### Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1.228+
- Modern Industrialization 2.5.5–2.5.x
- KubeJS 2101.7.2+
- Java 21

### Documentation

- [KubeJS API Reference](https://github.com/atmosstudioteam/mi-multiblock-editor/blob/main/docs/KUBEJS_API.md)
- [Complete Multiblock Examples](https://github.com/atmosstudioteam/mi-multiblock-editor/tree/main/examples)
- [Project Repository](https://github.com/atmosstudioteam/mi-multiblock-editor)
